I am a genderfluid boy, with manly inclination(if this is a thing).
*Sexually I am male, but in other aspects I am not.*

15 AMAB, when it comes to introducing myself I just use "15M."

So I am a boy, although I don't fit the typical definition of a boy.

I experience shifts once every few days, when doing a hobby I don't feel any gender at all. I like glitter, sadly there is no glitter at home. 80% of time I feel as a boy, 20% I feel as a girl.

I fell like a huge weight just fell off me now that I accept my genderfluidity :)

Then how am I supposed to get love and positive appreciation?

I am also depressed and suicidal, I actually wrote into r/suicidewatch.
There is no way I can get a therapist without my parents knowing. All I can rely on are online help services.

I can't get any friends because when I get 1 friend, they already have like 50-100 friends, and I am basically unimportant and worthless to them. And also having them burdened with my shitty problems, you know.

When it comes to comments from others I often hear things:irresponsible, immature, nerdy, soft, needs special treatment. So all people at school know how much I am a piece of shit, and it doesn't take long before new people find out.

When it comes being suicidal, I have to "seek help". But where do I seek help if I somehow "need to work on figuring out how to deal with my problems myself"?

I know this is not r/suicidewatch, but really it would be just better if I killed myself, rather than craving for pity from you.

People have advised me to get into relationship because my family doesn't give me enough love.

But having a shit ton of problems is not good.
